title: uragoga schweinfurthii
intro: Uragoga schweinfurthii, commonly known as the "Bitter Leaf" or "Afang", is a plant species in the family Urticaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in West African and Southeast Asian cuisines and is valued for its medicinal properties, including its potential to support digestive health and lower blood pressure due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Uragoga schweinfurthii include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and diuretic properties, which may help to reduce swelling, protect against cell damage, and promote urination. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions and provide a basis for its traditional medicinal use.
